job.title: Software Engineer, AML
job.pay_full: $165,000 – $181,500 a year, plus standard company benefits

details.about: SoFi is a next-generation financial services company and national bank that uses mobile-first technology to help millions of members reach their financial goals. Social Finance, LLC is hiring a Software Engineer for its Anti-Money Laundering (AML) function in Seattle, building end-to-end software with both frontend and backend parts.
duties: Work with cross-functional teams to design, architect and build end-to-end solutions across frontend and backend
Partner with senior engineers in the Anti-Money Laundering function to turn business needs into solutions, metrics and dashboards for insights and data visualization
Design and develop robust, scalable and secure server-side applications and APIs
Work with databases and data models, and build and maintain scalable data pipelines
Optimize performance, keep systems stable and contribute to architecture discussions
Follow design patterns and best practices, and test thoroughly (unit, integration and end-to-end)
needs: Master's degree (or foreign equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering (any field) or a related quantitative discipline
2 years of experience in the job offered or a related occupation

Skills in: Java; Python; AWS; Agile; Test Driven Development; SDLC; CI/CD pipelines; Jira; GitHub/GitLab or similar; Spring Boot; React; SQL; data structures; JavaScript; design patterns; operating systems; microservices; Docker
Any suitable combination of education, training and experience is acceptable
details.benefits: Salary $165,000 – $181,500 a year and standard company benefits; the final base pay offer depends on experience, skills and location.
notes: Hybrid work from SoFi's Seattle offices; part-time telecommuting is an option
Apply with the button on the posting (or by email, as the posting describes), quoting Req. 1014.27.2
Accommodations are available for candidates with disabilities
